source.note: The 27-arm/split comparison uses verified reasoning-v3 SFT results, completed GRPO results, and the new GRPO-compute-matched continued-SFT controls. All values use the same frozen-baseline question identities.

training.continued_sft_plot_note: Continued SFT starts from original SFT weights and matches GRPO estimated training FLOPs within 0.005%; one seed, approximate dense FLOPs.
training.compute_note: Continued-SFT budgets are matched to completed 10,000-update GRPO estimated training FLOPs. Accounting counts padded input positions after initialization; source-SFT work is excluded. These are estimator-based FLOPs, not hardware-counter measurements.
